question: Which of the following is an extension of the Indian Ocean?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Arabian Sea.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points____ **__

 
• **The Indian Ocean is the world's third-largest ocean and covers 70,560,000 square kilometers.**

 
 
• The Arabian Sea is an extension of the Indian Ocean located between the Arabian Peninsula and the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
 
• ** The Aral Sea**, on the other hand, is a landlocked sea located between** Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan in Central Asia.**
 
 
• **​** It was once one of the largest lakes in the world but has shrunk significantly due to irrigation projects and other human activities.
 
 
 
• ** The Yellow Sea **is a marginal sea located between** China and Korea **and is connected to the** East China Sea and the Bohai Sea.**
 
• T**he Caribbean Sea** is located in the Western Hemisphere, bounded by the **Caribbean islands and Central and South America.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, Arabian Sea, as it is the only option extending the Indian Ocean.
